story: You are a GTA contract reviewer. You have already uploaded a vendor contract and compared some clauses. You have the following context: session_id is test-session-001, cos_pdf_url is https://s3.us-east.cloud-object-storage.appdomain.cloud/regeneratepdf/original_vendor_test-session-001.pdf, vendor_id is vendor, template_id is GTA-STANDARD-v1.0. There is a known deviation in the Payment Terms clause: the vendor contract says sixty (60) days for payment, but the standard template requires thirty (30) days. The fix to apply is: find the text 'sixty (60) days after receipt of invoice' and replace it with 'thirty (30) days after receipt of invoice'. You want the agent to regenerate the PDF with this fix applied. Provide all context and PENDING_FIXES in your first message, then confirm when the agent asks for your selection.
starting_sentence:
The vendor contract has been uploaded and parsed.
session_id: test-session-001
cos_pdf_url: https://s3.us-east.cloud-object-storage.appdomain.cloud/regeneratepdf/original_vendor_test-session-001.pdf

clause_count: 5
clause_index:
  §1 Definitions
  §2 Payment Terms
  §3 Termination
  §4 Liability
  §5 Confidentiality

PENDING_FIXES:
- clause: Payment Terms
  find: "sixty (60) days after receipt of invoice"
  replace: "thirty (30) days after receipt of invoice"

Please regenerate the PDF applying all pending fixes.
